resolution_method: runtime probe of candidate suffixes in order ('', '.PRO', 'm', '.raw', '.stp', '.a') against adapter.symbol_info(); candidate accepted only if trade_mode != 0 (tradeable) and contract_size > 0; mapping LOCKED after first successful resolve (no silent re-mapping).
no_guessing: suffix is never assumed; plain-name, .PRO, and other variants are all probed at runtime. Test L_symbol_suffix_resolution proves .PRO-only brokers resolve correctly; test L_symbol_resolution_fails_on_no_tradeable proves disabled symbols fail closed.
note: Broker metadata is DESCRIPTIVE in R2 — nothing is executed. The frozen contract specs in the R0 truth lock are RESEARCH_REFERENCE_ONLY; live metadata is read dynamically from MT5 (broker_metadata_layer already ADOPTED per R1).
